cover.title: VC12 · Production Application Capstone · cover
cover.caption: Identify the lesson and its central decision at a glance. Deliver and explain an AI-assisted application with independently checkable release evidence.
cover.alt_text: cover for Production Application Capstone: Deliver and explain an AI-assisted application with independently checkable release evidence.
cover.extended_description:
Deliver and explain an AI-assisted application with independently checkable release evidence.

A study-task application is deployed to a test environment, tested through creation and reload, and checked with two users for isolation. A release report links the exact commit, test outputs, deployment, README and rollback procedure. An unresolved security failure blocks approval even if the UI works.

Deliver and explain an AI-assisted application with independently checkable release evidence.

practice_evidence.alt_text: practice evidence for Production Application Capstone: Deliver and explain an AI-assisted application with independently checkable release evidence.
practice_evidence.extended_description:
Submit requirements, architecture decisions, implementation, repository and Git history, working UI, applicable backend/data, tests, security checks, deployment, E2E evidence, README and a reflection distinguishing agent output from your verification.
Inspect the worked example, make your own attempt, record the outcome and explain one limitation.
If a tool or environment is unavailable, save an explicitly unexecuted plan as a draft; it does not satisfy an execution requirement.
